text:
Incident Bot: PAGED: P1 - gpu-node-17 is experiencing repeated GPU driver resets (Xid 13) and ECC events. Auto-escalation triggered.
Ava (oncall): acked. I'm on it, looking at metrics and node state.
Ava (oncall): quick snapshot: backend model route `text-gen-prod` shows 5xx spike and token-generation latency up ~3x. Customers hitting `text-gen-prod` might see timeouts.
Maya S.: re @Ava any customer calls? Which tenants impacted?
Ava (oncall): preliminary: acme-analytics and beta-account-7 saw failed requests. ops-bot pulled logs, attaching counts.
ops-bot: GPU ECC count on gpu-node-17 increased from 0 to 47 in last 10m. Driver reset count: 5.
Leo T.: can you paste the dmesg / nvml lines?
Ava (oncall): pasting relevant dmesg snippet:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 13, pid=4123, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 12345.678905] NVRM: GPU at 00000000:01:00.0 has fallen off the bus.
[ 12345.679010] EDAC MC0: CPU0: MCE 0: CE page 0x1a2b3c4d: ECC fatal?
```
Ava (oncall): kubectl shows several pods on that node in CrashLoopBackOff / OOMKilled.
Ava (oncall): `kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide | grep gpu-node-17`
```
text-gen-prod-5c8d7    0/1  OOMKilled   3          12m   gpu-node-17
reranker-2f9b8         0/1  CrashLoop   7          10m   gpu-node-17
```
Ravi K.: looks like GPU HW instability -> driver resets -> containers crash when they access GPU memory. Could be ECC fault or bad PCI connection.
Maya S.: are the other nodes seeing similar Xid counts?
ops-bot: query: last 1h Xid events per node:
- gpu-node-05: 0
- gpu-node-08: 1
- gpu-node-17: 52
- gpu-node-21: 0
Ava (oncall): plan: 1) cordon gpu-node-17, 2) drain with pod eviction so critical pods reschedule to healthy nodes, 3) attempt driver soft-restart on node, 4) if continues, reboot node and escalate to hardware team.
Jen P.: +1. Also we should scale up dedicated capacity temporarily to absorb traffic, move critical jobs.
Ava (oncall): running commands now:
```bash
kubectl annotate node gpu-node-17 maintenance-by=ava-1925 --overwrite
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Ava (oncall): pods are evicting. I see text-gen-prod rescheduled onto gpu-node-05 and gpu-node-08. Latency is falling back but some in-flight requests still failing (retries in progress).
Leo T.: attempt soft driver restart steps posted for reference:
```bash
ssh root@gpu-node-17
sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced || true
sudo rmmod nvidia_uvm nvidia_drm nvidia || true
sudo modprobe nvidia && sudo modprobe nvidia_uvm
# check nvidia-smi
nvidia-smi -q
```
Ava (oncall): attempted soft restart. `modprobe nvidia` failed: 'Unknown symbol in module' (shows trace). Driver appears inconsistent.
Ava (oncall): next step: reboot node. Scheduling now. ETA ~2m.
ops-bot: creating incident ticket INC-4532 and paging hardware oncall.
ops-bot: notify: hardware-oncall@redwood (pager) 
Ravi K.: I'll take over if reboot doesn't clear ECC counts. If counts remain high after reboot, we need to decommission GPU and run memtest diagnostics.
Ava (oncall): reboot done. Node came back up. `nvidia-smi` shows one GPU with ECC errors persistently:
```
$ nvidia-smi -q | grep -i ecc -A2
    ECC Mode                   : Enabled
    Single Bit ECC Errors      : 129
    Double Bit ECC Errors      : 4
```
Maya S.: double-bit ECC errors are bad — hardware team should tag as likely failing card.
Ava (oncall): pods rescheduled OK. `text-gen-prod` error rate back down to baseline; a few customer retries completed.
Jen P.: do we have customer impact summary? I can draft a short note for support.
Ava (oncall): yes — brief impact: 12 failed requests for acme-analytics between 12:03–12:12 UTC, 5 requests for beta-account-7. No SLA breach expected if retries succeeded; recommend support reach out to acme-analytics proactively.
Leo T.: logs show two container OOMKilled entries. Likely when drivers reset, process couldn't recover and hit oom while retrying allocations. We'll correlate with autoscaler events.
Ravi K.: hardware ticket updated: GPU slot 1 on gpu-node-17 flagged. Requesting replacement GPU and physical inspection for PCI seating/cable.
Ava (oncall): handoff: I'll remain monitoring for 30m, then hand to Ravi for overnight. Follow-ups:
- escalate hardware replacement (INC-4532)
- add node to capacity-deprecate list until GPU replaced
- run model-level regression to confirm no quality regression from pod reschedules
- draft incident summary and assign postmortem owner (Maya).
Maya S.: happy to own postmortem. I'll pull logs for dmesg, kube-events, and model eval traces.
Jen P.: support note to send (short): "We observed transient errors impacting a subset of requests to text-gen-prod between 12:03–12:12 UTC due to GPU driver resets on a single node. Most requests recovered after automatic rescheduling; we're replacing the affected GPU and will follow up."
Ava (oncall): tagging next oncall: @Ravi K. will be primary after 30m.
Ravi K.: taking handoff at 12:50 UTC. I'll keep hardware engaged and validate replacement. If we see repeat Xid events on other nodes, escalate to infra.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-4532 created and linked. Status: Mitigated (node cordoned + GPU replacement requested).
Ava (oncall): closing active paging; monitoring remains open. Will update incident doc with timelines and logs.
Maya S.: postmortem checklist noted. Good job team. :thumbsup:
